title_zh: 两天打卡八个景点的特种兵式旅游
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (12/20): Special Forces Travel: Eight Sights in Two Days
note_en: 打卡 (dǎkǎ) originally meant "to punch a time card," but online it now means visiting a place and posting proof: 两天时间，要打卡八个景点 "in two days, we're going to hit eight sights." Notice the time phrase 两天时间 comes first, before the verb, where English would usually put "in two days" at the end.
